files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
format: one JSON file per entity, files[<entity>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows": [[values in column order]]}; rows hold every series group the entity ever had staff or flows in
manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
spec: doj_core (docs/metric-spec.md) by series group (D-061, D-062); D-023, D-024, D-027

known_breaks.note: DRP wave: 4,816 departures effective Sep 2025 (signed known break, D-012 settled by D-021)
headcount fell 3,860 in Oct 2025 as the Sep 2025 departures left the snapshot (signed known break, D-012 settled by D-021)

columns.name: entity
columns.description: 'DOJ' for the department total, else the component's agency_subelement_code (pipeline/crosswalks/components.csv); display names belong to the front end

columns.name: series_group
columns.description: job series group (D-062): a listed occupational_series_code, or 'other' for every other code including blank and NULL; pipeline/crosswalks/series_groups.csv

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'month', 'quarter' (fiscal) or 'fy' (FY2025 = Oct 2024 to Sep 2025)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'YYYY-MM', 'FYyyyyQn' or 'FYyyyy'

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: fiscal year of the period

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.description: fiscal quarter 1 to 4 (Q1 = Oct to Dec); null at fy grain

columns.name: period_first_month
columns.description: first calendar month of the period (YYYY-MM), published or not

columns.name: period_last_month
columns.description: last published month of the period (YYYY-MM): the month stocks are taken from

columns.name: months_in_period
columns.description: calendar months in the period: 1, 3 or 12

columns.name: months_published
columns.description: months of the period with a published employment file, up to the entity's last employment month (D-024)

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': flows counted by personnel_action_effective_date_month (invariant 6)

columns.name: file_version
columns.description: one entry per published month of the period: 'YYYY-MM eN aN sN' = employment, accessions and separations file versions in the current manifest

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: the period contains any of the newest 3 effective months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: the period has months not yet published, or months after the entity's last employment month (invariant 3, D-024)

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: a month of the period changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json); false on the first build

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: a month of the period OPM marks incomplete for DOJ; currently none

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: rows in the employment file of period_last_month

columns.name: headcount_change
columns.description: headcount minus the headcount of the previous period of the same grain and entity (D-025); null for the first period; not derived from flows (invariant 7)

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective in the period

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective in the period (all codes; transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_quit
columns.description: departures with separation code SC (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_retirement
columns.description: departures with separation code SD + SE + SG (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_rif
columns.description: departures with separation code SH (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_termination
columns.description: departures with separation code SJ (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_other
columns.description: departures with separation code SL (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: departures with drp_indicator = 'Y', any code; an overlay outside the partition

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: hires with accession code AA (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: acc_new_hire
columns.description: hires with accession code AC + AD + AE (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: net_flow
columns.description: hires minus departures; not derived from or reconciled to headcount change (invariant 7)

columns.name: years_of_service_lost
columns.description: sum of length_of_service_years (years, one decimal, as published) over departures effective in the period; null values and values matching an active known data issue (D-026) are left out, see coverage

columns.name: yos_known
columns.description: departures with a non-null length_of_service_years that matches no active known data issue; the coverage numerator

columns.name: yos_known_issue
columns.description: data-quality count: departures whose length_of_service_years matches an active row of pipeline/known_data_issues.csv and is treated as unknown (D-026); left out of years_of_service_lost and yos_known

columns.name: years_of_service_lost_coverage
columns.description: yos_known / departures for years_of_service_lost; null when there are no departures

columns.name: attrition_a_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null when fewer than 12 months exist, i.e. before Sep 2012): all departures; rate = attrition_a_num / rate_a_den

columns.name: quit_a_num
columns.description: quit rate numerator, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null when fewer than 12 months exist, i.e. before Sep 2012): departures SC (sep_quit); rate = quit_a_num / rate_a_den

columns.name: retirement_a_num
columns.description: retirement rate numerator, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null when fewer than 12 months exist, i.e. before Sep 2012): departures SD + SE + SG (sep_retirement); rate = retirement_a_num / rate_a_den

columns.name: rate_a_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the three rates, method A, trailing 12 months ending in period_last_month (null when fewer than 12 months exist, i.e. before Sep 2012): mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_a_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (D-027); never 0

columns.name: rate_a_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_a_den

columns.name: rate_a_small_base
columns.description: rate_a_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when the rate is null

columns.name: attrition_b_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized (D-023): all departures; rate = attrition_b_num / rate_b_den

columns.name: quit_b_num
columns.description: quit rate numerator, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized (D-023): departures SC (sep_quit); rate = quit_b_num / rate_b_den

columns.name: retirement_b_num
columns.description: retirement rate numerator, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized (D-023): departures SD + SE + SG (sep_retirement); rate = retirement_b_num / rate_b_den

columns.name: rate_b_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the three rates, method B, fiscal year only (null at month and quarter grain); a partial fiscal year is year to date over its published months, not annualized (D-023): mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_b_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (D-027); never 0

columns.name: rate_b_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_b_den

columns.name: rate_b_small_base
columns.description: rate_b_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when the rate is null

columns.name: attrition_c_num
columns.description: attrition rate numerator, method C, annualized per period over its published months: all departures times 12 / rate_c_months; rate = attrition_c_num / rate_c_den

columns.name: quit_c_num
columns.description: quit rate numerator, method C, annualized per period over its published months: departures SC (sep_quit) times 12 / rate_c_months; rate = quit_c_num / rate_c_den

columns.name: retirement_c_num
columns.description: retirement rate numerator, method C, annualized per period over its published months: departures SD + SE + SG (sep_retirement) times 12 / rate_c_months; rate = retirement_c_num / rate_c_den

columns.name: rate_c_den
columns.description: shared denominator of the three rates, method C, annualized per period over its published months: mean of the month-end headcounts of rate_c_months months; null, with null numerators and flag, when that mean is 0 (D-027); never 0

columns.name: rate_c_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_c_den

columns.name: rate_c_small_base
columns.description: rate_c_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when the rate is null
